instruction: Please help me shift the text box to the right edge. I want to align it to the right side of the canvas.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the user to move the text box to the right side instead of the left. The evaluator checks if the rightmost dark pixel (text) is beyond 95% of the image width. Similar difficulty to the original task, just opposite direction.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: text box aligned to right side of canvas
Metric logic is semantically correct: scans each row from right to left to find rightmost dark pixel across entire image, then checks if beyond 95% of width
95% threshold is appropriate for 'right side' verification - allows small margin while ensuring right alignment
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file retrieves exported PNG from VM -> metric receives file path as result_state -> opens with Image.open(result_state) at line 30
Postconfig properly exports GIMP .xcf to PNG format (Shift+Ctrl+E + filename + confirmation), necessary for pixel-level analysis
Rule-based evaluation correctly uses empty expected dict (get_rule returns config['rules'] directly)
Edge case handling: returns 0.0 if no dark pixels found (right_most_dark_pixel=0), returns 0.0 if result_state is None or invalid, exception handling for file operations
Complete coverage: single requirement (right alignment) fully verified by positional check
The two-loop structure is correct: inner loop scans right-to-left per row and breaks after finding rightmost dark pixel, outer loop checks all rows to find global maximum x-coordinate
Metric DOES consume vm_file at line 30 (Image.open(result_state)) - rule validator warnings are false positives
